group.description: The kind's group, if several types share it.

group_by.description: Group relationships by direction (default) or by relationship type.

include_relationships.description: Return the item's relationships. Default true.

include_spec.description: Return the item's spec. Default true.

kind.description: Only needed when the name is ambiguous.

relationship_limit.description: Maximum relationships returned. Default 50, clamped to 200.
